independentVisualDecision.observedAgainstR05: The hard bright wedge or thin vertical sheet-like pull immediately outside/below the commissures is reduced. The neighbouring skin transition appears broader and more continuous while the central lip shape, contact line and pucker remain.
independentVisualDecision.observedAgainstCandidate02: The pronounced upper/outer stepped horizontal bands, sharply angular dark hollow and stacked ridges that made candidate02 unacceptable are visibly reduced in candidate03 at75% and100%. The comparison is particularly clear in the original full-progress frontal view and75% oblique view.
independentVisualDecision.whyRetain: This preserves the earlier local benefit while visibly reducing its main new side effect. In the personally inspected views, no comparably prominent new bulge, cavity or hard distant transition fold replaces it. That is sufficient for this reviewer to retain a narrowly scoped peripheral motion correction.
independentVisualDecision.remainingDefects: The commissure tip is still sharp, fine outer folds and a residual upper-side crease remain, and the inner lip edge still reads thin. Overall material realism and full-lip physiology are not accepted by this decision.
independentVisualDecision.scope: Personally inspected all six original candidate03/R05 full-oblique,full-macro and75%-oblique images, plus the original candidate02 full-macro and75%-oblique images for direct comparison.25% and50% are numerically reviewed here, not claimed as personally inspected images.
independentVisualDecision.hypothesisLimit: The controlled difference supports the value of redistributing the complete pucker vector. It does not isolate which share of the visual benefit came from up versus front, or prove component mismatch is the sole cause of every lip defect.

pixelLocalization.roiSelection: The same predeclared oblique corner ROIs [150,240,255,380] and [455,240,600,380] are reused. Top-left image coordinates and exclusive right/bottom bounds. Macro measured only as fullframe.
pixelLocalization.interpretation: Pixel differences localize response; they are not quality scores. Exact visible-triangle mapping remains unavailable from diagnosis01, so no selected native endpoint is asserted to be the frontmost cause of a particular pixel.

actualBinding.method: Screened positive rest-graph redistribution of the complete native pucker increment using the identical matrix for x, up and front, with fixed core and exterior boundary values
actualBinding.coreRule: Union of native top.lips, all samples.rim, original pairs, and native roi with abs(u)<=1 and 0<=v<=1.05; plus exactly one full-index neighbour ring. Negative-v and oral points are ineligible for edits.
actualBinding.exteriorRule: Same-side native type<.5, inner<=.005, v>=0, front>.25, depth<6mm; native exterior vertical region; free points exclude core and abs(u)<=.64
actualBinding.fades: Coefficient g: u .64-.84 and 1.5-1.6; front .25-.75; depth 3.5-6mm; 1mm outer vertical fades. Domain is not cut 4mm from the lip core.

solver.method: Diagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients on the symmetric positive-definite correction system; actual residual recomputed

actualBinding.sourceValues: Current before-local native pucker difference relative to pucker=0 with every other local action held fixed; x/up/front use one identical matrix; zero for originally inactive vertices; no posed displacement stored at install

graphAndProtectionAudit.comment: The actual geometry has49pair slots/98vertex slots/98unique IDs. Those counts are observed separately rather than assumed. Direct protection does not by itself prove final-stage equality or whole-surface contact.

candidate02Isolation.scope: The actual unchanged before-local SHA256, unchanged graph/domain records, exact full x-solver reports and all recorded x source/solution/correction examples corroborate the source-level isolation. These records do not serialize or hash the entire scalar x solution vector, so that stronger claim is not made. Final Cartesian x coordinates/pixels are not expected to be equal because the added up/front vectors and downstream native stages can also affect them.

progressInterpretation: The same graph and protected domain remain bound at25/50/75/100%. All samples use132/133/132 iterations for x/up/front and zero bound clamps, with finite source checks. Total correction and each component response grow smoothly over the sampled values; up follows the retained nonlinear native transverse formula. Small changed-vertex count differences are consistent with Float32 writes, not a changing free mask. Static samples do not certify every in-between derivative, collision or interactive frame rate.
